The '''Priole Danna system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions.<ref name="New Territories" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Priole Danna Festival]],<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Priole Danna Festival]]|system=Priole Danna [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> a celebration of [[Music/Legends|music]], parades and dramatic reenactments that was held annually on the<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_1.html|Priole Danna Festival Still a Go}}</ref> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC Lamuir">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Lamuir system/Legends|Lamuir system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamuir IV]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Priole Danna system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-5.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
